title: The Quarry's Trail
text: Fresh tracks lie deep and wide apart in the mud, the claws dragging. Whatever you are hunting passed here not long ago, and it was hurt; there is blood on the leaves at shoulder height. If you are slow, the next blood will be yours.

options.label: The best tracker follows the blood while it is still fresh.

outcomes.text: It leads straight to where the quarry rests, licking its wound. It does not hear you coming.

options.label: The craftiest sets a trap on its trail in case it doubles back.

outcomes.text: It never comes back this way, but the waiting sharpens everyone.

options.label: Run it down now, while it bleeds and before it heals.

outcomes.text: It is not as hurt as it looked. It was leading you.
